# SteamLite 10.1.2

A fix for SteamLite freezing when you add games from the Start menu.

- Fixed: Add a game > From the Start menu opened every shortcut one after another and waited for each, which froze the background part of SteamLite for a minute or more. Nothing loaded and the minimise and close buttons did not work until it finished. The shortcuts are now read together in the background, which takes about a second.
